knownVariance.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: Straight-on dial photo in even light so date-window alignment can be discussed.
knownVariance.whatPhotosCannotShow: How the date changes through the month, lume duration, or how the dial looks in person under mixed lighting.

knownVariance.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A sharp dial photo that shows lume plot shape and placement on the markers.
knownVariance.whatPhotosCannotShow: Lume brightness after hours, color shift, or consistency across a batch.

knownVariance.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A rehaut photo that shows whether laser etching is visible around the inner ring.
knownVariance.whatPhotosCannotShow: Etching depth, durability, or how the rehaut looks off-camera at other angles.

knownVariance.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: Close photos of clasp code and end-link fit against the case.
knownVariance.whatPhotosCannotShow: How the clasp feels in hand, long-term wear, or bracelet stretch.

highValueChecks.sellerQuestion: Can you send a straight-on dial photo in even light so date-window alignment and lume plots can be discussed?
Can you send a rehaut photo that shows whether inner-ring etching is visible?

notes: Curated starting checklist only. Missing a required photo means that area cannot be assessed from submitted images. Factory version vsf-current is a qualitative snapshot, not a production-date score.
